g5-implement.title: Gap 5 (oracle_all_states permutation ValueError): implement
g5-implement.imperative: Dispatch implementer for gap 5. Root-cause: oracle_lap_n_positions from get_race_start_order may have fewer drivers than the race features field (e.g. a driver recorded Q but not race_start_order for that round), causing the strict-permutation check in _validate_sampled_positions to fail. The oracle_all_states backtest then raises non-fatally inside the runner.py for-loop, leaving oracle_all_states event_count=0. Fix: In src/evo_predictor/sampled_runtime.py (or wherever oracle positions are applied before _validate_sampled_positions), when oracle_all_states is the mode and oracle_lap_n_positions does not cover all feature drivers, convert the missing drivers' lap-N positions to use their quali positions as fallback (already available in oracle_grid_positions from the same race) — dense-filling the field to a valid permutation. If no quali position is available for a missing driver, skip that driver's oracle position (keep original model prediction for that slot) rather than raising. The fix must be in the oracle-state application layer (sampled_runtime.predict or _apply_oracle_state), NOT in _validate_sampled_positions (that validator is correct). Test: unit test with synthetic oracle_all_states inputs where oracle_lap_n is missing one driver; assert the backtest scores successfully (no ValueError) and the missing driver falls back to quali position.
